Definition

For a real- or vector-valued function $f$ on $M$, define \[ \operatorname {supp}f=\overline{\{ p\in M:f(p)\neq 0\} }. \] The function is supported in $U$ when this support lies in $U$, and compactly supported when the support is compact. Every function on a compact space is compactly supported.
